title: Rune Song
description: Adds the Rune Song from Core Keeper to a Minecraft Resource Pack
body:
Adds the Rune Song From Core Keeper to Minecraft by renaming a Netherite Sword to "Rune Song""

Currently only works for 1.21.5, I will try and hopefully upload one that works with CITReswen

"Core Keeper" is owned by Pugstorm Games
